name: little-snitch
description: Read and change the Little Snitch firewall on a Mac, with every change approved in the macOS administrator dialog.

interface.longDescription: Ask which apps connect where, why a connection is blocked, and which rules apply. With your permission it can also add, change and remove rules and switch profiles; each change is approved in the macOS administrator dialog, and a backup is saved first.
defaultPrompt: Use Little Snitch to show which hosts this app connected to today.
Use Little Snitch to find out why this connection is blocked.
Use Little Snitch to check the firewall status.
